name: Li Xiaohong
current_role: Co-actual controller and shareholder (~6.72%), Luoyang Jalon Micro-nano New Materials Co. (688357.SH)
profile: Li Xiaohong is listed alongside chairman Li Jianbo as an ultimate controller of Luoyang Jalon Micro-nano New Materials, a Luoyang, Henan maker of molecular sieves and activated alumina founded in 1998 and listed on Shanghai's STAR Market in 2019. Her wealth derives from that stake.
interesting_fact: Jalon Micro-nano, founded in 1998 as Luoyang Jianlong Chemical, makes molecular sieve powders and molded molecular sieves used in industrial gas separation and purification; it listed on the STAR Market in 2019.
notes: Controller listing (Li Jianbo 27.71%, Li Xiaohong 6.72%) per basic.10jqka.com.cn/688357/holder.html. Her own executive role and relationship to Li Jianbo not confirmed in sources read. Low public profile; route via company IR / chairman Li Jianbo.
